info.title: semver
info.description: Calculate semantic versions from Git history and Conventional Commits.

options.name: --prefix
options.description:
Literal tag prefix for monorepo
scenarios
determine the version

options.name: --folder
options.description:
Repository-relative folder whose commits
determine the version

options.name: --prerelease
options.description:
Prerelease label; the matching commit
count is appended automatically

options.name: --buildmetadata
options.description:
Include the effective HEAD short SHA as
build metadata

options.name: --output
options.description: Text       Output format: text or json
